content.description: The exact preimage of JCS(content), which the Delta's commitment covers (WIST-1 §3.6). The `maxLength` bounds below count code points; the normative caps on `extract`, `links` and `summary` count octets of a JCS serialization and are stated in WIST-1 §3.6, which governs where the two differ. A validator MUST check the octet caps itself — JSON Schema cannot express them.

links.description: The page's external links: `urls` is the first-N external Normalized URLs in raw-HTML document order (WIST-2's extraction procedure), `total` the count of ALL distinct external links before truncation. Each `urls` entry's `maxLength` is a code-point first pass; the octet caps (link_url_cap_bytes per URL, links_cap_bytes for JCS of this object) are stated in WIST-1 §3.6 and govern.
